english.title: Enter a compulsory ticket area without valid ticket for the whole journey on the Croydon Tramlink system
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) entered a compulsory ticket area at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) on the Croydon Tramlink system when you did not have with you a valid ticket for your entire journey
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 19(1) and 26 of the Croydon Tramlink Byelaws made under section 46 of the Croydon Tramlink Act 1994.

english.notes:
(a) No person shall be in breach of this Byelaw if
(i) at the time when and the tramstop where he started his journey there were no facilities for the issue of the necessary ticket for his journey; or
(ii) there was a notice displayed at that tramstop indicating that it was permissible for passengers beginning a journey at that tramstop to enter a tram without a ticket; or
(iii) an authorised person gave him permission to travel or enter a compulsory ticket area without a valid ticket. (Byelaw 19(3)).
(b) No person at a tramstop or a station compulsory ticket area shall be in breach of this Byelaw unless he came there by alighting from a tram. (Byelaw 19(4)).
